shared_tail.surface: سعيد بن زيد بن عمرو بن نفيل

notes: Two isnads of the same saying (Sa'id's account of the ten): both are read as routes, and the one written «قال سمعت سعيد بن زيد» after the last branch is their shared tail (rule 3)

Second route: «وسفيان» begins it, joined to the head at ابن إدريس; «ذكر سفيان رجلا فيما بينه وبين عبد الله» says an unnamed man stands in Sufyan's route, but the text does not place him, so no link is written
The Ashja'i remark («رواه الأشجعي عن سفيان ...») names a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, never a route (rule 4)
«قال أبو داود» is the compiler's remark, not a transmitter; the Prophet is the end; «- قال ابن إدريس ... آثم -» is a gloss
